layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one adventure-map site, a chunky building or landmark seen from the front with the camera slightly above it, like the trees, mountains and towns of the same map: we see its front face and a little of its roof, never a plan from straight above. Thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail. It stands alone on the empty transparent background with nothing under it: no ground patch, grass, soil disc, platform or shadow; its bottom is the lowest thing in the image.

Subject: a frost giant's barrow, a creature bank: a big burial mound of packed snow and pale blue ice #9fd0ea with a dark doorway framed by huge grey standing slabs #7a808c at the front, icicles hanging off the lintel, a giant horned iron helmet and a broken frosted axe on top of the mound, each image a different size of it: a small modest one, a medium one, a large grand one, and another large grand one. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.

style_image.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout
